output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the owner calls mintToken, the balanceOf and totalSupply variables are updated without a check, allowing the owner to set these values to a very high amount, granting arbitrary tokens to the owner.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens from the user's account to any address, including a compromised exchange, due to a wrong logic in the function.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is set to 1, it can cause an overflow in the buy function, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the msg.value is set to a very low value, it can cause an overflow in the buy function, allowing attackers to steal funds.
